body:
Fellow Conservative,

We’ve all recently seen why it’s even more critical now that our Republican candidates win at all levels in the rapidly approaching 2022 Midterm Elections.

The radical Biden Democrats have escalated their abuse of power against the American people by pushing the so-called “Inflation Reduction Act” on Capitol Hill - which hangs another $739 billion spending boondoggle on American taxpayers to hire thousands and thousands of new IRS agents - and actually makes inflation worse as we slide further into the Biden Recession.

Fellow Conservative, as a top Republican supporter, you understand the historic need to win new GOP Majorities in both Houses of Congress - and win state and local races across the country - to sweep the radical, destructive Democrats out of power and bring Joe Biden’s disastrous agenda to a screeching halt.

Now it’s time to tell you how your Republican National Committee is planning to make that happen.

**Exceptional ground game.**

If you’re wondering what that means, let me explain. The RNC is recruiting thousands of volunteers to go door to door as well as call residents in communities across the nation.

Essentially, our unmatched data-driven ground game and a grassroots army of volunteers is spreading the Republican Party’s message in every community across the country!

Our commitment to engage with voters at the community level is how we will take back the House and Senate this November. Elections are won on the ground, which is why I am emailing you today. name: Ron Johnson
subject: Please, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

Vote for Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen to keep Massachusetts in Republican hands
| | | |
---

| Well, it's official: Boston's liberal elitist newspaper has endorsed Geoff's liberal elitist opponent in the Republican Primary.
Yawn.
What more would you expect from the Globe? They endorsed Geoff's opponent because they know he is unwilling and incapable of pushing back against their extreme agenda.
The Boston Globe and Geoff's primary opponent have much in common: they both gave Hillary Clinton the nod for President in 2016. It's no wonder they now embrace each other so warmly.
Geoff purposefully refused to pander to the Globe for their endorsement. In fact, he rejected an invitation to meet with their editorial board. Geoff and the Globe don't represent the same values or the same vision for Massachusetts, so why play the game?
We've got news for the Boston Globe: Geoff isn't running to gain the Globe's favor. In fact, he's actually running against the extreme liberal elitist ideology that spills over the Globe's editorial pages every day.
On September 6, you are being asked to make a choice in the Republican Primary.
On the one hand, you can follow the liberal elitist vision of the Boston Globe and vote in the Republican Primary for someone who does not represent the Republican Party, its mission and its values. His name is Chris Doughty, and he is spending millions of dollars in a negative campaign to convince you he's something he's not (that is, a true Republican).
On the other hand, you can vote for the Diehl-Allen ticket, the only conservative ticket in the race. Don't just take our word for it -- party faithful endorsed Geoff and Leah at the Republican State Convention by two-to-one margins over their opponents.
Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen are the only ones who will protect your rights, your freedoms, your wallet, and your kids in school. They are the only ones who will fight for first responders and small businesses. And, they are the only campaigns credibly pushing against driver's licenses for illegal immigrants and against higher taxes. That's why they aren't endorsed by the Boston Globe -- Geoff and Leah are on your side, not the Globe's.
Trust us, we wouldn't have it any other way.
The choice is in your hands.

They want to go further than the Supreme Court
| | |
---
Friends —
I have about 15 minutes of free time in my schedule today. I know that doesn’t sound like a lot of time, but with a schedule like mine, I can assure you it’s a gift.
And while I know our campaign sends a lot of emails your way, I want to take a few of these minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place — and why your support today is so important to our success.
The truth is: When Gabby and I first started talking about running, we weren’t sure what to expect. We knew that Arizona needed new leadership in the Senate — someone who would always put the people of our state first, who was willing to work across the aisle to deliver real results, and who would prioritize building bridges between the two parties — not burning them down.
We also knew we had some friends who would help us out. But when you’re talking about such a big campaign, we realized we’d need support from a lot of people we hadn’t met yet. Especially since I was making the decision to reject corporate PAC money.
You know the rest. We won in 2020 in large part because we ran the biggest grassroots campaign Arizona has ever seen.
But now we have a new mission: Re-election.
And we’ve got our work cut out for us. The stakes were high before, but now it’s more critical than ever that we win this race. Because the Senate is the final defense against a national abortion ban in the United States.
And in Arizona, the candidate that Trump just endorsed against me wants to go even further than the Supreme Court. He’s called for a national ban on abortion. He’s said abortion rights were “demonic.” And he backs a law that would jail abortion providers.
I know times are tough, but we can’t give in now. We need to make sure a ban like that never happens. Which is why I have to ask:

https://www.facebook.com/TNVoterProject [https://www.facebook.com/TNVoterProject]
August 29, 2022
Dear friend,
Remember the moment in 2020 when we found out that Georgia turned blue? If you're anything like us, we were glued to our phones and TV's waiting to hear the outcome. We knew the incredible work that many organizers, including Gubernatorial candidate Stacey Abram's organization the New Georgia Project [https://www.politico.com/news/2020/11/08/stacey-abrams-believers-georgia-blue-434985] , had done to turn out progressive voters in the last decade.
Spoiler alert: their work paid off and turned Georgia blue, decisively bringing our country back to more empathetic leadership and people-centered policies. You know how they secured this major win? They encouraged progressive-minded people to register to vote [https://fivethirtyeight.com/features/how-georgia-turned-blue/] .
HELP TVP REGISTER PROGRESSIVE VOTERS [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpaug17_1]
Tennessee is faced with the same opportunity. It might be easy to put our heads down and concede to the idea that Tennessee will always be red but if we put in the work now, we can shift the trajectory of our state.
The Tennessee Voter Project [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpaug17_1] exists to register and turn out as many voters as possible. The voter registration deadline for the November 8th [https://www.electionsshelbytn.gov/elections/state-and-federal-general-bartlett-collierville-germantown-lakeland-and-millington] election is Tuesday, October 11, 2022. That may seem far away but we've got to get ahead of it and reach every progressive non-voter we can. If you know someone who isn't registered to vote, they can do so here [https://ovr.govote.tn.gov/] .
Every dollar you contribute helps us to turn out voters and expand participation in our democracy. Together, we can turn Tennessee blue.
Thank you for your support,
Tennessee Voter Project Staff

## God Is BIG, Really BIG
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14270327.8139.1.33640ff9c3a76bf94cd2eb0a08b6bf14)
---
**God is so much bigger than what we think...**
God introduces Himself to Abraham in _Genesis 17:1_ as "**God Almighty**."
God describes Himself as **Omnipotent**.
**Omni** means "**all** " while **Potent** means "**power** , **might** , **ability** " (where we get the word _potential_). **Omnipotent** means **all powerful** , **all might** , **all strength** and **all potential**.
Everything that exists (_every planet_ , _every star_ , _every tree_ , _every bird_ and _every person_) comes from God and yet God is still Omnipotent. That means **He can do more than what He has done** (_potential_).
**God Almighty has placed tremendous potential inside each of us** because He created us with a purpose.
**Purpose is why something exists**.
**Potential is the ability to accomplish purpose**.
Potential precedes purpose.
But you can have potential and never fulfill your purpose. **How can that be**?
There is a process for potential to manifest into purpose.
I want to encourage you to check out the message I preached yesterday at [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14270327.8140.1.d8ea80e2170e593e765807de1ceb662c) in Tulsa, OK about the process of potential.
In my opinion, this is the most impactful message I have preached as of yet.
Watch the message [here](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14270327.8141.1.694b31aa0ca638938d7c360fecf95f57): [https://youtu.be/u_G0I0CHPtc?t=1](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14270327.8142.1.033ef1d6f41a9a7a6532b381b2e80dd8)

Folks – I’ve never been one to back down from a challenge.
When I ran for State Senate for the very first time, I lost, but I didn’t give up. I ran again and won. Serving the people of New Hampshire as State Senator, and then as Governor, is the honor of a lifetime.
When I decided to run for the U.S. Senate, I knew it wouldn’t be easy, but I also knew I could make an impact for Granite Staters and for Americans. So I fought hard to unseat the Republican incumbent, winning by the tightest margin of any sitting U.S. Senator.
Now I’m in a battle for reelection, and it’s going to be even closer. **[But with the support of people like you, friend, pitching in $3 we’re building a team that I hope you’ll join that’s ready to take on the race ahead.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49914575/363952492/-1829049351?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&amount=3&refcode=mh-jtk1504-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzE2YWUyMS1iMDI3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7TjxiYtW9XAaUnEUp3ZBTnA6gCx49fkyANUZdinzqJw=)**

That’s why they are spending over $25 million smearing me.
But we’re not going to let them win, team. I’ve won tough fights before, and this time will be no different. But it’s going to take all of us. **[That’s why I’m asking for your support. We’ll need every resource possible to stay in this fight and win it. body:

| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **He bragged that he erased 100K of personal debt without help. You could too if you work hard like him...**
_Yup. This past weekend, L'il Marco Rubio told you if you could just write a book like he did (Anyone has time for that! We all get Fridays off like Senators, work half the year and get free tv time to promote our books!), you'd get out of debt! Easy-peasy, right!?_ **“I owed over $100,000 in student loans, the day I got elected to the Senate I had over $100,000 still in student loans that I was able to pay off because I wrote a book and from that money I was able to pay it.”** If this sounds like an insult, it is. Marco took advantage of his government position and high profile for profit. So the rest of us who can't do that...are just lazy and willing to be in debt? Yep, in the world according to L'il Marco. It gets worse, though. You see, Marco had the Florida Republican Party credit card handy to abuse. You have that too, right?? Take it away, Tampa Bay Times: "..**The Times Herald**** _obtained Rubio's statements from 2006 and 2007, showing he routinely charged personal expenses[ ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5cc13a71-cc6d-424f-9bb6-45cb4dafb788/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)from a $10.50 movie ticket to a four-day, $10,000 family reunion._** [**Join us in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can to Val Demings.** Let's give Val Demings a Senate seat, and give Marco back his Florida GOP credit card. He clearly needs it.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T447c0374-819d-47e5-92d5-0c23b98ad5dd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **From January of 2005 until October of 2008 I charged about $160,000 in party-authorized expenses. "**** ****_Who's the con man again?_**

Election denying political leaders continue to spew out misinformation and create a hostile work environment for hard working election workers.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49924421/363967023/-532505380?refcode=EM_F_220829EWorkers_EOM_MTO_90DO180DC_N_N_LOGO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcyMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OTkyNWZkMi1iNzI3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0HyzdhQfmZp6kk0fb7FKR8t383yeJtsA7jDE2saH4-I=)

Election workers have been caught in the crossfire of election-denying rhetoric, and _I simply will not stand for it._

It is impossible to have a fair democracy if we do not protect the people who administer and secure our elections. Due to heightened harassment and threats election workers have faced, people are becoming discouraged from taking on the job – leaving our elections system stretched thin. This is exactly what election deniers want, and we can’t let it continue.

**Unprecedented challenges to our democratic way of life require experienced, steadfast leadership to meet this moment. I am working every day to face down these challenges and deliver for New Mexico.**
[**_I’ve worked every day to make sure our elections are safe, secure, and transparent – including fighting for the safety and protection of election workers. With just two days left to raise the remaining $2,875 we need to reach our goal, I wanted to reach out to you. Election-denying political leaders continue to spew out misinformation and create a hostile work environment for hard-working election workers. We need strong leaders in office who are ready to fight back against these growing conspiracy theories.

I care about the well-being of all workers who dedicate their time and efforts to helping New Mexico’s democracy. No election would be possible without them which is why I want to make sure they feel safe, secure and recognized in their jobs.
[**_Election workers are an essential part of our democracy, and I won’t tolerate any threats of violence or harassment towards them. Join me today in fighting to protect our democracy and those who make it possible by donating $25 now. →_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49924481/363967087/-532505380?refcode=EM_F_220829EWorkers_EOM_MTO_90DO180DC_N_N_l2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcyMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OTkyNWZkMi1iNzI3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0HyzdhQfmZp6kk0fb7FKR8t383yeJtsA7jDE2saH4-I=)

Maggie

name: Rand Paul
subject: If you read one email today, let this be it
body:
You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox: [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6381%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=n52UqmbQ1X2gnx%2fZ7EkKtg&sysid=1)
[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75984%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AQavmYkmqkUp8D00kW2%2boA&sysid=1)

Friend,

You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox:
* Big tech is silencing pro-liberty voices
* Universities are running amok with radical socialists
* The mainstream media openly lies to the public
* Corporate America has embraced Woke propaganda
* Pelosi and her cronies are passing a radical agenda in Congress

Despite all this: _**Yes, there is hope for the future**_.

_What if I told you the thing that gives me the MOST hope are our college students?_ You’d think I was crazy. Aren’t they all radicals too?

**Wrong. **

A group of college students is fighting for liberty and may be one of our greatest chances of saving our Republic. Here are a few of their recent victories...
* Helped pass Constitutional Carry in Texas, Indiana, and Alabama!
* Helped expand School Choice in Kentucky, Arizona, and Missouri!
* Adding over 250 hardcore pro-liberty legislators to a national coalition across the country!
* SUED dozens of college campuses and restored free speech rights to over 1.5 million college students!

College students are lining up to defend Constitutional principles and grow a coalition of liberty legislators across the country. Here’s how they are doing it.

Allow me to personally introduce Lauren Daugherty. She is the CEO of Young Americans for Liberty (YAL). YAL is the most active and effective pro-liberty youth organization advancing liberty on campus and in American electoral politics.

**Friend, I told Lauren I would help YAL raise $23,000 online. It will go directly towards YAL’s work to fight for laws that advance liberty, train students to become door knockers before the 2022 elections, and so much more. I am asking for your immediate support now to get 1,000 students mobilized for freedom. **

[_**Donate $10 >>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75995%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=r2F3YV%2fYLc%2f7T2sxSzx7GQ&sysid=1)

[_**Donate Any Amount >>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75991%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BAwnciKKpt3n%2bHNotqvMpQ&sysid=1)

Here’s how it works.

> **First:** YAL recruits tens of thousands of students across college campuses. These students start and join an active YAL chapter where they fight back against leftist bias on campus.
>
> **Next:** YAL takes the top student leaders and brings them to top notch trainings. There, students are taught how to transform their campus and fight for liberty candidates and causes in the legislature.
>
> **Then:** Thousands of student activists recruited and trained by YAL knock on doors to push liberty legislation, and turn out the vote for liberty-minded candidates running for office.
>
> **Finally:** These liberty legislators pass bills to defend freedom of speech, protect the 2nd Amendment, and expand free markets.

The results speak volumes of this successful formula to make liberty WIN:

YAL’s student activists have helped elect over 250 pro-liberty legislators, repealed 99 unconstitutional free speech codes and regulations, and have started chapters on over 500 college campuses across the country.

All of this hinges on training the next generation of liberty patriots.

name: Pat Harrigan
subject: Last email I’ll ever send
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jake Ellzey for Congress
body:
I’m opening my heart to you today in hopes you’ll stand with me. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6991%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=7neJW60EV0MQd9q3Imf5uQ&sysid=1)
I’m opening my heart to you today in hopes you’ll stand with me.
[](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74736%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LCkJdaILZycwE1EqJQCYnQ&sysid=1)

Friend -

This is the first and last email I’ll ever send you.

You see, I’m a little unsure about opening up to you this way.

**But the deck is stacked against us, my back is against the wall, and your response to this message will decide everything. **

name: Trudy
subject: Peter, I'd love your input on this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
Could you please take a few minutes to complete our campaign's first general election priorities survey?
| | |
---
Peter,

I’m Trudy Busch Valentine: a nurse, mother, children’s advocate, proud fourth-generation Missourian, and, **as of a few days ago, your Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Missouri.** I’ve spent my life giving back and helping others, and now I’m running to do the same thing in Washington. I hope you’ll take just a moment to read about what’s at stake and why I'm in this race.
As a young girl growing up in Missouri, I watched my parents live the American Dream. They always told me, “To whom much is given, much is required.” That sense of obligation to help others is what drove me to choose a life of service.

It’s why I volunteered as a candy striper when I was only 13 years old. It’s what led me to attend nursing school, work in hospitals, and later, work for the Salvation Army.
It’s also why I’ve decided to run for U.S. Senate;** Missourians deserve a senator who will put politics aside, put people first, and work to make sure that everyone is able to live out the American Dream. Now, as we head into the general election, I need to hear from top Democratic supporters like you, Peter. **
[**So I'm asking a favor: Could you please take a few minutes to complete our campaign's first general election priorities survey? Your feedback is essential to helping me understand where to focus our efforts so that we can develop a winning strategy for November.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49925190/363968312/-2043110283?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk246-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjVjODQ4Ny1iODI3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cqeZcgzMVrk3Ety4PS5Sn-lJVfXhQqLIUUkW5AE4doI=&emci=8d78c9a9-2723-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=d65c8487-b827-ed11-bd6e-281878b914e7&ceid=4450063)

I've been fortunate in life. I’ve never had to fight to get the healthcare I need. I’ve never seen an eviction notice on my door. I’ve never worried about paying my electric bill.

But too many Missourians have.
These days, the American Dream seems to come with a price tag – and that price is way too high. That’s why I’m ready to help lower the cost of basic necessities. I’m ready to expand access to affordable healthcare. I’m ready to fight for a person’s right to choose. And I’m ready to put an end to our state’s tragic opioid epidemic.
Peter, we’ve known for too long that Washington is broken, with leaders dividing rather than uniting us. Missourians know that we need more compassion and less politics. To truly solve problems, we need leadership that puts politics aside and puts people first – and that’s exactly what I’m ready to do as your next U.S. senator.
**But look: I believe leaders should talk less and listen more – and that’s why I’m reaching out to you as we kick off this campaign.[This is our campaign’s very first general election priorities survey, and your answers today will help guide the strategy to fix a broken Washington and rebuild our great state. I’d be so grateful for your input.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49925192/363968314/-2043110283?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk246-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjVjODQ4Ny1iODI3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cqeZcgzMVrk3Ety4PS5Sn-lJVfXhQqLIUUkW5AE4doI=&emci=8d78c9a9-2723-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=d65c8487-b827-ed11-bd6e-281878b914e7&ceid=4450063)**
While working in the hospital, I cared for children, seniors, and people from all walks of life. It’s also where I learned the importance of quality healthcare. As a nurse, I believe that every person deserves access to the very best medical care, and as a parent, I believe that every person should have access to contraception and abortion care – full stop.
Now that the Supreme Court has overturned Roe v. Wade, we're in an uncertain and scary time. **We don’t know what will happen next, but here’s what I do know: You can count on me to work for the rights of ALL Missourians.**
But I can only run a winning campaign if grassroots input is at the center of our strategy. **[So, Peter, will you help start the general election strong by responding to our priorities survey? Your opinion means a lot to me.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49925193/363968315/-2043110283?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk246-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjVjODQ4Ny1iODI3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cqeZcgzMVrk3Ety4PS5Sn-lJVfXhQqLIUUkW5AE4doI=&emci=8d78c9a9-2723-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=d65c8487-b827-ed11-bd6e-281878b914e7&ceid=4450063)**

Fellow Patriot,
Some families decided against accruing the costs associated with sending their children off to college because it was an unrealistic financial burden.

So their children have risen to the occasion by hustling for scholarships, working multiple jobs, or pursuing an alternate path to learn a marketable skill and earn a viable livelihood.

Biden’s student loan bailout announcement just betrayed all these American families by making them responsible for monies they were unwilling to spend for their own futures, or for their own progeny.
https://secure.anedot.com/b5c81bee-6e5f-4118-91cb-3dab5c3f0037/bidens-student-loan-fiasco?utm_source=Tyler+Lee+for+Congress&utm_campaign=1137eef422-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_07_19_10_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_ac8d25e432-1137eef422-617881201
I myself had over $40,000 in student loan debt from going to Liberty University that I DO NOT expect anyone to pay off – other than myself! Just as I wouldn’t expect someone else to pay off my car note, mortgage, or creature comforts! School was a choice I made that I alone am responsible for.

During these inflationary times, when Americans need strategic and disciplined leadership, the Biden Administration has thrown all caution to the wind along with billions of taxpayer dollars in multiple directions all at once.

The unending aid to Ukraine, 87,000 new IRS agents, and now a student loan bailout that could cost taxpayers over
$1 TRILLION. Enough is enough!

When elected to Congress, I will fight against the reckless federal spending that is saddling an unbridled amount of debt on Americans and exacerbating our recessionary dilemma. Together we can make our stand to fight against this Socialist Marxist theft of Americans’ hard-earned dollars.

With your support of a donation in any amount today, I will be fortified in my efforts to remove the checkbook from swindling politicians like Joe Biden:

body:
I want to quickly explain exactly what we're fighting for – and why winning here in Georgia matters so much.

Our movement is about building a better, brighter future for _all_. It's about ensuring that everyone has an equal voice in our government – and a fair shot at the American dream.
That means defending and expanding our constitutional right to vote. It means protecting reproductive freedom nationwide. It means making health care more affordable, bringing economic justice to our communities, and lowering the everyday costs that make it difficult for too many families to make ends meet.
Friend, our movement is about _you_ – your priorities, your concerns, your hopes for the future. That's why it's so important to have you by my side for the critical fights ahead – fights we can only win if we win this election first.
You see, polls show me 1 point behind my GOP opponent, Herschel Walker – who seems to care more about courting favor from Donald Trump than he does about addressing the issues that matter to Georgians. But GOP donors are pouring over $20 MILLION into his campaign to defeat me, and I can't fight back without your help.

So I want to quickly explain exactly what we're fighting for – and why winning here in Georgia matters so much. Our movement is about building a better, brighter future for all. It's about ensuring that everyone has an equal voice in our government – and a fair shot at the American dream. That means defending and expanding our constitutional right to vote. It means protecting reproductive freedom nationwide. It means making health care more affordable, bringing economic justice to our communities, and lowering the everyday costs that make it difficult for too many families to make ends meet. Friend, our movement is about you – your priorities, your concerns, your hopes for the future. That's why it's so important to have you by my side for the critical fights ahead – fights we can only win if we win this election first. You see, polls show me 1 point behind my GOP opponent, Herschel Walker – who seems to care more about courting favor from Donald Trump than he does about addressing the issues that matter to Georgians. body:
Hi Derek, my
name is Charlie Crist, and I just became the Democratic nominee for
governor of Florida.

My opponent? Gov. Ron DeSantis, one of the most dangerous Republicans
nationwide.

Ron DeSantis has been using Florida as a testing ground for some of the
most cruel and divisive culture war tactics of the last two years. He has
been setting himself up as a likely presidential contender, and it’s been
working.

DeSantis signed one of the first vile “Don’t Say Gay” bills. He attacked
Disney and the Special Olympics when they opposed his policies. He’s even
created an “elections police” unit that people fear will be more about
voter intimidation than voter protection.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1558?amount=10&refcode=TE_EM_FR_3MU_20220827_1_1&t=1001&akid=4281%2E1827488%2EhnIgdP ]DeSantis’s next act is to run for president in 2024, and that’s why I’m
writing to you today. This election is our last, best chance to stop Gov.
DeSantis’s national ambitions and get Florida back on track. We can
accomplish both by defeating him on November 8th, so I hope you’ll make a
contribution today to split between my campaign for governor and Tony's.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation
will be split between Tony Evers and Charlie Crist and processed immediately.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1559?amount=10&refcode=TE_EM_FR_3MU_20220827_1_1&t=1002&akid=4281%2E1827488%2EhnIgdP ]Donate $10 Now

By using the governorship as a stepping stone to run for president in
2024, DeSantis has shown he doesn’t have Florida’s best interests at
heart.

But I’ve always put Floridians first. From my time as a state senator to
serving as Florida’s 44th governor, I’ve lived my life by the Golden Rule,
working to build unity rather than fueling division.

Fortunately, Floridians are waking up to Ron DeSantis’s horrible agenda.
Multiple polls have shown me either neck and neck with him or outright
beating him, so I know this fight is winnable. DeSantis only won by 0.4%
in 2018. A recent Axios article said “Florida swing voters view Ron
DeSantis as too extreme.”

Beating DeSantis won’t be easy, but nothing worth doing ever is.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1558?amount=10&refcode=TE_EM_FR_3MU_20220827_1_1&t=1008&akid=4281%2E1827488%2EhnIgdP ]Together, we can make Ron DeSantis a one-term governor and ensure he
never steps foot anywhere near the White House. Can I count on you for a
donation that will be split between my campaign and Tony's?

Thank you,

Charlie Crist

body:
Politics can be nasty.
#
Hi Derek,
Gisele here! ❤️ I just want to check in with you before the end of August. It’s been a really busy month, and I can’t believe that the kids are back in school already.
**I’ve said it before and I’ll keep saying it until something changes: Politics is so icky.**
From Dr. Oz’s grotesque comments on João’s stroke, to the flood of dirty Super PAC money in races like ours, decency is on the ballot this November (and so much more).
**And now Donald Trump — perhaps the least kind of them all — is coming to our beautiful Commonwealth at the end of the week.**
Derek, we’ve seen that where Trump goes, the dirty PAC money follows. That means we can anticipate even more MAGA money flooding into Pennsylvania after his visit.
My husband is running a clean and honest Democratic campaign. That means our campaign will never accept dirty corporate PAC money. No million-dollar Wall Street checks.
We fund our campaign this way because we believe it’s the only right way. Because when we say we're people-powered, we really mean it.
And more importantly, we are running a campaign that our family is proud of — and we hope you are proud of it, too.
**[So I’m asking: Will you please make a contribution right now to help us hit our ambitious goal of $2.5 MILLION for João’s campaign? We only have until Wednesday at midnight to reach our goal.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220829-1?refcode=em20220829-7014&refcode2=7014_434096_2R89Yu&akid=7014%2E434096%2E2R89Yu)**

**4 seats** : That is the number of seats Republicans need to take back the House. While this shouldn’t be a big lift for us, Democrat’s enthusiasm has been building for months.

body:
The voter registration deadline is coming up fast, friend. Our team needs your help.

| |
---
Friend, we have just _**6 weeks**_ until the Texas voter registration deadline. **There is so much at stake this November. Friend,

You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox:
* Big tech is silencing pro-liberty voices
* Universities are running amok with radical socialists
* The mainstream media openly lies to the public
* Corporate America has embraced Woke propaganda
* Pelosi and her cronies are passing a radical agenda in Congress

Despite all this: _**Yes, there is hope for the future**_.

_What if I told you the thing that gives me the MOST hope are our college students?_ You'd think I was crazy. Aren't they all radicals too?

**Wrong. **

A group of college students is fighting for liberty and may be one of our greatest chances of saving our Republic. Here are a few of their recent victories...
* Helped pass Constitutional Carry in Texas, Indiana, and Alabama!
* Helped expand School Choice in Kentucky, Arizona, and Missouri!
* Adding over 250 hardcore pro-liberty legislators to a national coalition across the country!
* SUED dozens of college campuses and restored free speech rights to over 1.5 million college students!

College students are lining up to defend Constitutional principles and grow a coalition of liberty legislators across the country. Here's how they are doing it.

Allow me to personally introduce Lauren Daugherty. She is the CEO of Young Americans for Liberty (YAL). YAL is the most active and effective pro-liberty youth organization advancing liberty on campus and in American electoral politics.

**Friend, I told Lauren I would help YAL raise $23,000 online. Here's how it works.

> **First:** YAL recruits tens of thousands of students across college campuses. These students start and join an active YAL chapter where they fight back against leftist bias on campus.
>
> **Next:** YAL takes the top student leaders and brings them to top notch trainings. There, students are taught how to transform their campus and fight for liberty candidates and causes in the legislature.
>
> **Then:** Thousands of student activists recruited and trained by YAL knock on doors to push liberty legislation, and turn out the vote for liberty-minded candidates running for office.
>
> **Finally:** These liberty legislators pass bills to defend freedom of speech, protect the 2nd Amendment, and expand free markets.

The results speak volumes of this successful formula to make liberty WIN:

YAL's student activists have helped elect over 250 pro-liberty legislators, repealed 99 unconstitutional free speech codes and regulations, and have started chapters on over 500 college campuses across the country.

| | Derek, I have about 15 minutes of free time in my schedule today. I know that doesn’t sound like a lot of time, but with a schedule like mine, I can assure you it’s a gift. And while I know our campaign sends a lot of emails your way, I want to take a few of these minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place — and why your support today is so important to our success. The truth is: When Gabby and I first started talking about running, we weren’t sure what to expect. We knew that Arizona needed new leadership in the Senate — someone who would always put the people of our state first, who was willing to work across the aisle to deliver real results, and who would prioritize building bridges between the two parties — not burning them down. We also knew we had some friends who would help us out. But when you’re talking about such a big campaign, we realized we’d need support from a lot of people we hadn’t met yet. Especially since I was making the decision to reject corporate PAC money. You know the rest. We won in 2020 in large part because we ran the biggest grassroots campaign Arizona has ever seen. But now we have a new mission: Re-election. And we’ve got our work cut out for us. The stakes were high before, but now it’s more critical than ever that we win this race. Because the Senate is the final defense against a national abortion ban in the United States. And in Arizona, the candidate that Trump just endorsed against me wants to go even further than the Supreme Court. He’s called for a national ban on abortion. He’s said abortion rights were “demonic.” And he backs a law that would jail abortion providers. I know times are tough, but we can’t give in now. We need to make sure a ban like that never happens. **A Message from Peter ( & Luis):**
On August 22, 2022, I was honored to receive an endorsement from none other than my previous, **Democrat opponent** , Luis Acevedo-Arreguin. As a strong advocate for Latino representation, Luis sent me the following (translated) endorsement: _To the Migrant Community of District 18,__Our country is living in very difficult times because of the division that has been created by allowing individuals to decide which party best represents their values & principles. To tell the truth, it is very difficult for a person to find all his ideals represented in one party. For example, Latinos & Latinas can find our ideas of a better immigration system in one party, while the other party respects our fundamental rights as living beings. Nevertheless, both parties are working to build a prosperous economy that allows us to have a decent & well-paying job.__I launched a candidacy to unify minorities from California Congressional District 18 and to see our ethnic groups better represented in U.S. Congress. But also to put an end to the unlimited re-elections of a group of legislators from both parties; those who have had permanent power for decades.__That’s why I have now considered the only option we have in District 18 to increase the strength of our minority communities is to support the candidacy of:__Peter Hernandez_ _Through his work ethic, I’ve seen his vision that seeks to improve the immigration processes for our county. Peter supports a better economic policy that benefits the middle working class & low-income minorities. His work is a constant reflection of his respect for our rights enshrined in the Constitution.__Respectfully,__Luis Acevedo-Arreguin_
**Thank you, Luis, for your powerful words & unwavering support. I look forward to representing our Latino community in Congress, as we fight to retire out-of-control government. #RetireZoe **

clean_body: Help us #GetTheVoteOut - the clock is ticking! It's time retire out-of-control government. | | | A Message from Peter ( & Luis): On August 22, 2022, I was honored to receive an endorsement from none other than my previous, Democrat opponent , Luis Acevedo-Arreguin. As a strong advocate for Latino representation, Luis sent me the following (translated) endorsement: To the Migrant Community of District 18,Our country is living in very difficult times because of the division that has been created by allowing individuals to decide which party best represents their values & principles. To tell the truth, it is very difficult for a person to find all his ideals represented in one party. For example, Latinos & Latinas can find our ideas of a better immigration system in one party, while the other party respects our fundamental rights as living beings. Nevertheless, both parties are working to build a prosperous economy that allows us to have a decent & well-paying job.I launched a candidacy to unify minorities from California Congressional District 18 and to see our ethnic groups better represented in U.S. Congress. But also to put an end to the unlimited re-elections of a group of legislators from both parties; those who have had permanent power for decades.That’s why I have now considered the only option we have in District 18 to increase the strength of our minority communities is to support the candidacy of:Peter Hernandez Through his work ethic, I’ve seen his vision that seeks to improve the immigration processes for our county. Peter supports a better economic policy that benefits the middle working class & low-income minorities. His work is a constant reflection of his respect for our rights enshrined in the Constitution.Respectfully,Luis Acevedo-Arreguin Thank you, Luis, for your powerful words & unwavering support. I look forward to representing our Latino community in Congress, as we fight to retire out-of-control government. #RetireZoe “Now more than ever we need fighters like you (Peter) in Congress.” - Steve Bannon Did you catch me on Bannon’s WarRoom Battleground (Ep. 125) ? Watch it now! (Don’t forget to SHARE with your online community or forward this email to your friends & family). You’re Invited: September 7th at the Fox Theater in Salinas, CA. subject: We cannot let Cheri Beasley fall short before her deadline.

body:
Cheri Beasley’s campaign in North Carolina is one of our best chances to flip a seat.
#

It has been devastating to watch Republicans roll back our rights in state after state after a right-wing majority on the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ in June.
I’m furious. Republican politicians are trying to make medical decisions that should be left up to a patient and their doctor. Period.
They are determined to pass a national abortion ban without exceptions for rape, incest, or cases where the mother’s health is at risk. That’s exactly what Cheri Beasley’s opponent supports, and it’s a big reason why we must stop McConnell’s super PACs from buying this election.
Outside groups are spending tens of millions of dollars against Cheri, and if she misses her August goal, she may not have the resources to fight back and flip North Carolina. She urgently needs our help.
[**Can you please make a $3 donation before Cheri’s deadline in two days? Her team had a fundraising slowdown this month, and they need a surge of support today to make up some ground.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220829-1-ma&t=1&akid=1585%2E357359%2EaKMX1E)
The last thing our country needs right now is more male politicians telling women what to do with their bodies. And we saw just this month in Kansas that voters agree.
This race was already in play, and frankly, Republicans’ radical anti-abortion agenda has made this race even more winnable.
But your support is critical if we’re going to flip North Carolina and secure a historic victory for Cheri in November. She needs us to have her back right now — to fight like hell and win this race.

VOTE ON ELECTION DAY NOVEMBER 8TH
Fellow New Mexico Conservative, we're running out of time. Republicans have heard you loud and clear, and are working up and down the ballot to secure our elections. Whether it's for the President, Governor or the local sheriff, you deserve to know that your vote counts - and it's counted fair & square. However, Democrats are working hard to dismantle the integrity of our elections: votes for illegals, ballot harvesting, voter ID bans, unsecure boxes and dirty voter rolls. While NM voters simply want secure, 1 person = 1 vote elections by eligible voters - the elitist Democrats are SPRINTING in the opposite direction. In contrast, the incumbent Democrat Secretary of State is leading the charge to make sure our elections are unsecured and vulnerable to outside interferences, by loosening election laws and unconstitutionally trying to legislate from her office. The incumbent along with her corrupt colleagues tried to pass bills that would make cheating in our elections easier. Those bills will return if re-elected. We must stop the corruption in our elections and fight for fair, honest, elections by electing a true "Freedom Loving Patriot" Audrey Trujillo for Secretary of State. Friend –
I’ll be honest with you. I never thought this is how it’d go.
When Gabby and I got married, I never thought this is the way things would turn out.
I never thought I’d run for public office. She was the elected official in the family, and on the International Space Station, I was about as far from Congress as you can get.
I never thought more than 1 million people would contribute and volunteer to help elect me.
And I never thought that I’d need to ask supporters to do more than that to defend this seat.
But I need to ask you to do more. We are facing millions of dollars in attack ads, the former president says beating me is the first step to “taking back America,” and we’ve missed a few fundraising goals in a row already this year.
So, please, friend. You may not have woken up this morning thinking you’d make a donation to my re-election, but **I really need you if we’re going to hold this seat.**

It's about us determining the overall direction of this country, and we all have a part to play.| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49910606/363945860/1060786640?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMDg2OGZkYS1hYzI3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ALuVLuz-cqozmxmlNsTVqf7wBixYz31byUlGcOiRE44=)

| | **Friend, what happens on Election Day isn't just about success in one campaign or another.**
**It's about determining the overall direction Pennsylvania and our country are headed in, and ALL of us have a part to play.**
---
**I'm Congressman Brendan Boyle, and I represent the City of Philadelphia in Congress. I'm reaching out today because from Pittsburgh to Philly, from York to Erie to Scranton, Pennsylvanians and our country are under siege like never before.**
---
[STAND WITH US](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49910609/363945863/1060786640?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMDg2OGZkYS1hYzI3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ALuVLuz-cqozmxmlNsTVqf7wBixYz31byUlGcOiRE44=)
---
| | **_Republicans in Washington and in Harrisburg are attacking our ability to vote, our freedom of expression, and womens' ability to make their own healthcare decisions.
_** **This is a fight that will play out in every city and town across Pennsylvania, and we need to win it by working together from one corner of our Commonwealth to the other.
** **Between now and November 8th I'll be campaigning across Pennsylvania to make sure we elect Democrats up and down the ballot this fall.** **And as I do that,_I'm asking everyone to join me in support of the work we Democrats are all doing in every part of Pennsylvania to defend our democracy. Because THAT is what's on the ballot this fall._**
---
[STAND WITH US](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49910613/363945867/1060786640?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMDg2OGZkYS1hYzI3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ALuVLuz-cqozmxmlNsTVqf7wBixYz31byUlGcOiRE44=)
---

---
**So we hope you'll support the work we're doing any way you can as we try to hold our Democratic majority in Congress, and to win locally and statewide here in Pennsylvania.** Everything you do makes a huge difference, and will be what helps put us over the top together on Election Day.
**We're fighting for the future of our Commonwealth and our country, and it's a fight we can't afford to lose. Thanks for standing with me.** All the Best, Congressman Brendan Boyle

subject: Who does Right to Work really benefit?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Tennessee Democratic Party
body:
Hint: it’s not workers.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49932926/363999162/1141538894?refcode=EM_C_220829LaborVid_EOM_Union_4_90DO180DC_G_N_logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZWIwYjI2Ni1jZjI3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=W3W1t7qNxj4pnBLIcaGoFMdfnDEUrezHrzFdMyPBGE8=) **"Right to Work is actually the right to work for less." - Yolanda Cunningham, CWA Local 3808** Let’s get one thing straight, the Right to Work amendment has nothing to do with worker freedom. In fact, it would strip workers from having a voice in negotiating wages, benefits, and safe workplaces. This is just another way the rich and powerful are trying to rig the rules against working families while pretending it’s in YOUR best interest.

**This legislation does not help working families. This legislation does not help Tennessee’s prosperity. It benefits special interest groups and greedy corporations.**

**We’re working with the AFL-CIO to highlight how actual union workers feel about this amendment. Click below to watch Yolanda Cunningham, member of CWA Local 3808, talking about who really benefits from Right to Work laws and why you should VOTE NO on 1.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49932927/363999164/-803653937?v=7aMBXKmXH3Y&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZWIwYjI2Ni1jZjI3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=W3W1t7qNxj4pnBLIcaGoFMdfnDEUrezHrzFdMyPBGE8=&emci=1a2ddb4d-6025-ed11-bd6e-281878b914e7&emdi=0eb0b266-cf27-ed11-bd6e-281878b914e7&ceid=6362892) This isn’t just about union members. When wages and benefits improve for unions, it actually improves for all workers. It is our mission to fight for a Tennessee that supports our working families. That’s why we need to back our unions and fight for better working conditions for all.

Onward,

body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61132980:65Q08EVNk:m:1:3317145305:422CD71BF65A2506C5AD6816C89F1B9A:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

Derek -- the Senate finally passed the _Inflation Reduction Act_ \-- a groundbreaking bill for the American people.
With the passage of this legislation, the Senate Democratic majority has accomplished what countless others have come to Washington promising to do. The _Inflation Reduction Act_ will lower the cost of prescription drugs, health care, and energy while reducing the deficit by making the wealthiest corporations pay their fair share. And we did it all without a _single Republican vote_.
Folks just like you helped make progress like passing the _Inflation Reduction Act_ possible. This team played a critical role in electing President Biden and Vice President Harris, holding our House majority, and flipping the Senate. Elections matter and this is proof.
**I’m feeling energized, and I hope you are too, Derek. If you can, please donate $7 to the Democratic National Committee before Wednesday's deadline so that we can protect our majorities in Congress this November and continue making a difference for American families.**

This team played a critical role in electing President Biden and Vice President Harris, holding our House majority, and flipping the Senate. Elections matter and this is proof. I’m feeling energized, and I hope you are too, Derek. If you can, please donate $7 to the Democratic National Committee before Wednesday's deadline so that we can protect our majorities in Congress this November and continue making a difference for American families. Friend,

I want to talk to you about my house. Not the House of Representatives, but my childhood home in Toledo, where I still reside today.

Where I come from, a house still means a lot. It represents family and the stake we hold in our community. My grandparents were Polish immigrants choosing to lay down roots and raise their families in Toledo. They instilled diligence and duty into my parents - mom worked in a spark plug factory where she served on the UAW organizing committee, and dad ran a small family grocery store.

I got my first lesson in economic injustice as a child when a meat supplier refused to sell my father high-quality beef for his store. I witnessed my father fight for the right of his working-class customers to have the same quality products as everyone else, and the supplier relented. At that moment, my path was laid out.

As the house was passed down, so too were the values of hard work and community service. Because my parents invested in me, I was the first person in my family to go to college. I worked in urban planning and development, but when my community asked me to step up and run for Congress, I answered the call.

I tell this story to illustrate the point that this district _**deserves**_ a representative in Congress who understands its unique needs. I have lived in this district, in the same house, for most of my life. My constituents are friends and neighbors, and I have been honored to serve them and fight for them.

Governing is not always glamorous. Crafting, amending, and passing legislation is a grueling process that requires the dedication and patience that my parents instilled in me. It involves identifying the needs of a community and then fighting hard to bring back the resources needed to help the region thrive.

From funding for job training in Toledo Schools or constructing the World War II Memorial to securing funding for a vegetable garden at a senior housing complex and holding back the Asian carp’s invasion of the Great Lakes, no project can be too daunting.

I love this district like I love my house. My work is both challenging and fulfilling. It is the highest honor of my life to serve our community. **I will always put forth my very best effort for the people of Northern Ohio because they deserve nothing less.**

**[This year, though, I face a tough battle to keep serving my community in Congress. The GOP is throwing everything they have at me, and I need your help. We hope you’ll take a moment to read it from beginning to end and hear why this community and this fight mean so much to Marcy. If you don’t have time (that’s okay!),= Friend, I want to talk to you about my house. Not the House of Representatives, but my childhood home in Toledo, where I still reside today. Where I come from, a house still means a lot. It represents family and the stake we hold in our community. My grandparents were Polish immigrants choosing to lay down roots and raise their families in Toledo. They instilled diligence and duty into my parents - mom worked in a spark plug factory where she served on the UAW organizing committee, and dad ran a small family grocery store. I got my first lesson in economic injustice as a child when a meat supplier refused to sell my father high-quality beef for his store. I witnessed my father fight for the right of his working-class customers to have the same quality products as everyone else, and the supplier relented. At that moment, my path was laid out. As the house was passed down, so too were the values of hard work and community service. Because my parents invested in me, I was the first person in my family to go to college. I worked in urban planning and development, but when my community asked me to step up and run for Congress, I answered the call. I tell this story to illustrate the point that this district deserves a representative in Congress who understands its unique needs. I have lived in this district, in the same house, for most of my life. My constituents are friends and neighbors, and I have been honored to serve them and fight for them. Governing is not always glamorous. Crafting, amending, and passing legislation is a grueling process that requires the dedication and patience that my parents instilled in me. It involves identifying the needs of a community and then fighting hard to bring back the resources needed to help the region thrive. From funding for job training in Toledo Schools or constructing the World War II Memorial to securing funding for a vegetable garden at a senior housing complex and holding back the Asian carp’s invasion of the Great Lakes, no project can be too daunting. I love this district like I love my house. My work is both challenging and fulfilling. It is the highest honor of my life to serve our community. body:
We missed our goal of finding 8,700 conservatives to sign our "Stop the IRS Petition" last week. We need your help to make sure that we hit our goal before this Friday.

| Last week, my team and I began to circulate a petition for which we were hoping to gather 8,700 signatures. The petition calls for the $80 billion recently allocated by the Democrats to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to be spent on a better cause, such as hiring 87,000 new border patrol agents.

**We didn't meet our goal, which is why I'm writing today. There is no scenario in which the federal government needs to hire 87,000 new IRS agents. None.**

If you missed taking a moment to sign my petition the first time it was sent around last week, **[please take a moment to sign it today.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61125029:J2AvkEVQN:m:1:3339843426:28CC07FED5D499B90C6DB49FFFF17E05:r)**

You can find the original email below for reference. Thanks,
Jim

\-----------------------------------------------

From: Jim Jordan
Date: Thu, Aug 18, 2022 at 11:33 AM
Subject: Help me stop the IRS
dpwillis67@gmail.com

Peter,

Can I give you yet another reason why Republicans need to take back the House in November?

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump's home over "documents" just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us**.

**In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?**

Sure, the Democrats claim they are just trying to squeeze every possible penny they can out of the American people to fund Biden's dangerous agenda.**But I think there is much, much more to this power grab.**

**Ask yourself this:** __Why not use that same $80 billion to hire 87,000 new border patrol agents instead? Better yet, why not let people keep their own hard-earned money for themselves and their families?__

**Please let me know if I can count on you as an ally in the effort to stop the Biden/Pelosi agenda that is taking our money, our freedom, and our country.[I'm asking you to be among 8,700 conservatives to sign a petition to stop the government funding for the 87,000 new IRS agents. Can I count on your signature between now and Friday.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61125029:J2AvkEVQN:m:1:3339843426:28CC07FED5D499B90C6DB49FFFF17E05:r)**

[** SIGN MY IRS PETITION BEFORE FRIDAY **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61125029:J2AvkEVQN:m:1:3339843426:28CC07FED5D499B90C6DB49FFFF17E05:r)
**Yes, showering the IRS with funds is about Democrats wanting more of our hard-earned money.** But to me, it's just as much about the fundamental choice that Americans have faced since our founding. It's about more freedom vs. more government control. **It's about whether we serve the government... or whether the government serves us.**

I need to hear from you today: **do you support Republicans taking control of the House in November, to stop this madness and return freedom, power and money back to the people?**

**[Can I count on you for your signature?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61125029:J2AvkEVQN:m:1:3339843426:28CC07FED5D499B90C6DB49FFFF17E05:r)**[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61125029:J2AvkEVQN:m:1:3339843426:28CC07FED5D499B90C6DB49FFFF17E05:r)

For freedom,

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61125029:J2AvkEVQN:m:1:3339843426:28CC07FED5D499B90C6DB49FFFF17E05:r)
Jim Jordan

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zu7os530tlben05t5je06blg9ih2l0d0cjbp84ng_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3g68ob4c5h2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

In many states, key decisions are pending that could have national impact.

The U.S. Supreme Court is allowing the 2022 elections **in Alabama** to proceed on a judicially determined discriminatory map that has just one majority-Black district favorable to voters of color out of seven congressional districts in the state -- even though Black people comprise more than one out of four voters there.

**In Georgia,** people of color account for much of the state’s population growth. But you wouldn’t know that from the state’s gerrymandered maps, which dilute the votes of Black people at the congressional and state legislative levels. A federal judge said that a decision in that case won’t come until after the 2022 election as well. Meaning the fight for fair maps and elections in Georgia is another fight for the long haul.

**In North Carolina,** Republicans are asserting a radical new theory according to which state courts would be unable to stop legislatures from enacting and implementing gerrymandered congressional maps. And if that sounds ominous, consider this: At least four U.S. Supreme Court justices have indicated an openness to this utterly groundless claim.

**Then there’s Texas,** where Governor Greg Abbott allegedly goaded the state legislature into intentionally and illegally diluting the voices of the very same voters of color who drove the state’s population growth. The U.S. Department of Justice is suing -- as are we.

The bottom line: Now is not the time to let our foot off the gas in this fight. body:
[](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=438fffb18ec149d6bb1929d369ca316a&_e=_OTTCx26P68vquSdeDCDD4AvM1-k8MZylD13bhJ4rN-nsXGGxbsDVNjMZ1ahd7wYVaNqfmG0PoEeNBA2UBAB9mtkBz7h5s9scAmDUxieHZkpNA5fqZdLEqePAXJVCtx49n_IgS_k3CJnMi-7Aw-YuktIhA8wgQ_F2nqYCxn8g2bKoYJVQPOofW4kkf85kOq4V224EqKrhkNc6w-9JQlFT0u5kyH2VTpYlBbmZd2gnDKhh0MSJMUVDwLp4vemAOPLIAInH2lEPNCtXZ9f1e3uWg%3D%3D)

Friend,

You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox:
* Big tech is silencing pro-liberty voices
* Universities are running amok with radical socialists
* The mainstream media openly lies to the public
* Corporate America has embraced Woke propaganda
* Pelosi and her cronies are passing a radical agenda in Congress

Despite all this: _**Yes, there is hope for the future**_.

_What if I told you the thing that gives me the MOST hope are our college students?_ You’d think I was crazy. Aren’t they all radicals too?

**Wrong. **

A group of college students is fighting for liberty and may be one of our greatest chances of saving our Republic. Here are a few of their recent victories...
* Helped pass Constitutional Carry in Texas, Indiana, and Alabama!
* Helped expand School Choice in Kentucky, Arizona, and Missouri!
* Adding over 250 hardcore pro-liberty legislators to a national coalition across the country!
* SUED dozens of college campuses and restored free speech rights to over 1.5 million college students!

College students are lining up to defend Constitutional principles and grow a coalition of liberty legislators across the country. Here’s how they are doing it.

Allow me to personally introduce Lauren Daugherty. She is the CEO of Young Americans for Liberty (YAL). YAL is the most active and effective pro-liberty youth organization advancing liberty on campus and in American electoral politics.

**Friend, I told Lauren I would help YAL raise $23,000 online. Join Michael Peroutka and his supporters in Maryland for a virtual prayer service on September 11th.

Faithful Peroutka Supporters,

Will you join us in prayer for the Patriots for Peroutka campaign?

We need:

- To give thanks for the landslide victory in the primary election.
- Protection from the dark forces of pure evil we are up against.
- More volunteers as our campaign gains momentum.
- Great financial support as our tiny army faces the tremendous battle ahead.

Most importantly we need prayers for Michael Peroutka who is being attacked on a daily basis for serving God.

On Sunday September 11th at 7:30 pm we will have a prayer service with Michael (in a private location) that will be broadcasted on YouTube. We would also like groups from every county in Maryland to come together at locations of your choosing and join Michael virtually on YouTube.

Will you coordinate a prayer group where you live?

“where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the midst of them.” Matthew 18:20

Plan accordingly and secure a space in your church, in a hall, or in a home. Have a computer ready to view the link, or view it on a large screen in your group.

Start today.

Send out invitations to conservative organizations in your area. Gather your Republican Clubs or Precincts together.

All 23 counties and Baltimore City together at once..... with God all things are possible!

Once you have your group organized, please send a quick reply back to let us know at least one group in your county has formed. We want to ensure that all 24 areas have representation.

| | | | | Peter, **He bragged that he erased 100K of personal debt without help. You could too if you work hard like him...**

We all get Fridays off like Senators, work half the year and get free tv time to promote our books!), you'd get out of debt! Easy-peasy, right!?_ **“I owed over $100,000 in student loans, the day I got elected to the Senate I had over $100,000 still in student loans that I was able to pay off because I wrote a book and from that money I was able to pay it.”** If this sounds like an insult, it is. It gets worse, though. You see, Marco had the Florida Republican Party credit card handy to abuse. You have that too, right?? While we didn’t have a lot growing up, my family believed that through hard work, you can achieve anything. It took me seven years to graduate college – and I juggled multiple jobs, from painting houses to pouring coffee – but I put in the hard work and earned that degree. My daughter was born 17 years ago, and my family’s hard work gave me the determination that I needed to leave the world a better place for her. That’s why I stepped up to join the Oregon legislature. As a legislator, I’ve fought for more affordable health care, helped Oregon begin to tackle our climate crisis, and passed the nation’s most progressive paid family leave bill. It takes hard work to get these things done, but I was determined. With that same level of determination, I’m running for Congress. I’m ready to fight for families just like mine in Congress, but I need your help. My team and I set a goal to raise $10,000 before the end of the month, because that’s what we need to raise to stay competitive in this race. He believed in the power of hard work to make a difference. He worked in the fields, served two tours in Vietnam, and took a union job to provide a path into the middle class for our family. While we didn’t have a lot growing up, my family believed that through hard work, you can achieve anything. It took me seven years to graduate college – and I juggled multiple jobs, from painting houses to pouring coffee – but I put in the hard work and earned that degree. My daughter was born 17 years ago, and my family’s hard work gave me the determination that I needed to leave the world a better place for her. That’s why I stepped up to join the Oregon legislature. As a legislator, I’ve fought for more affordable health care, helped Oregon begin to tackle our climate crisis, and passed the nation’s most progressive paid family leave bill. It takes hard work to get these things done, but I was determined. With that same level of determination, I’m running for Congress. I’m ready to fight for families just like mine in Congress, but I need your help. My team and I set a goal to raise $10,000 before the end of the month, because that’s what we need to raise to stay competitive in this race. clean_body: We have a real opportunity to strengthen our Democratic Senate majority, but we need your support. | | Derek -- with Florida’s Senate election, we have the opportunity to strengthen our Democratic Senate majority, and I want to ask you to join our campaign today. Now’s our opportunity to give it all we’ve got. I need you to step up and make your first split donation to support Senate candidates like me.Before Wednesday’s deadline, w ill you split a $10 donation between my campaign and the Democratic National Committee to help expand our Senate majority, defeat Marco Rubio, and elect Democrats nationwide? My unlikely story of opportunity is proof of what is possible -- and what should be possible -- for every American. See, I grew up poor in the segregated South, the daughter of a maid and a janitor. If you had told me back then, as a young Black girl, that I would be the first in my family to graduate college, become a congresswoman, and now be the official Democratic nominee in Florida’s Senate race...well, I just don't know if I would have believed you, Derek. What I did believe then -- and what I carry deep in my soul to this day -- were the words my hardworking parents used to say to me, "Never grow tired of doing good, Val -- never tire.” As Florida's next U.S. senator, I will never tire of the work to make sure the greatness of America is accessible and affordable for all Americans. I will never tire of continuing to do more good for you and your family. But when it comes to this race, the GOP won't tire either. I know a thing or two about running in a tough race, but I need your help because I can’t do this alone. ** With so much gratitude for all you do, Val Val Demings Candidate for U.S. Senate, Florida U.S. Representative, FL-10 The DNC's 2022 Congressional Split Series helps fundraise for and raise awareness around down-ballot Democrats in some of the most important races across the country. Team,
We recently got word that $1.6 billion – possibly the largest single contribution to a political organization – was given to a conservative non-profit group. These are the kind of groups that can raise and spend as much money as they want, and even though they’re technically a non-profit, they can still spend it on political advertising, without disclosing where the money is from, or where it’s going.
It’s a mind-blowing number on its own, but here’s some context to show you how insane one individual spending that much money is. Back in 2020, 15 politically active nonprofit organizations spent a combined $1.5 billion.
The group that received the money is led by a conservative activist that has supported everything from voting restrictions, to anti-choice and anti-climate change efforts, to supporting right-leaning Supreme Court judges. You can bet that that’s where this money is headed – and that it will be hard to trace.
Elissa has consistently fought to get dark money (the kind of untraceable money we’re talking about here) out of politics. And she, ahem, puts her money where her mouth is: she’s never accepted a dime of corporate PAC money because she never wants her constituents to question who she works for.
While this lets Elissa vote her conscience, and not on behalf of outside donors, it means that the only way Elissa is able to run for office is because of the generosity of the normal, dedicated people who support her. Average people who believe in Elissa enough to send her a few dollars here and there.

body:
Help us fight back and win this November.

| Peter —

It’s official: We have our Republican opponent in Arizona. Here’s what that means for our race:

Experts all over the country agree: Arizona is going to be one of the closest races in the country this year. And now that the stage is set for November, all eyes are on us.

And with more attention comes more money. Our opponent is backed by an out-of-state billionaire in the Silicon Valley, and his Super PAC can spend virtually unlimited sums of money on this race — whatever it takes to defeat us. National Republicans, corporate special interests, and dark money groups are ready to spend millions of dollars on attack ads.
