# **THIS WEEK IN BETSY BRIGADE NEWS**
### _Putting the People Back in Charge_
* * *
### **It’s Official: Betsy Makes the Ballot**
On Thursday, the Secretary of State’s office announced that Betsy has officially qualified for the November ballot! Thanks to everyone who collected signatures, signed petitions and volunteered this summer to put her name on the ballot!
* * *
### **Kotek & Drazan Too Extreme **
Did you see Betsy’s newest TV ad? Betsy will lead with the best ideas from both parties. She’s the only candidate who will get tough on crime and homelessness AND protect a woman’s right to choose. Neither Tina Kotek nor Christine Drazan can say that or would do that. [](https://www.runbetsyrun.com/extremes?e=40b20d4397498f3af7dfb5987b4a98d3&utm_source=rbr&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_week_in_brigade_news&n=2)
* * *
### **The Blue Backs Betsy**
Statewide law enforcement and crime victims’ organizations are uniting behind Betsy. In the last month, Betsy has received key endorsements from the Oregon State Sheriffs’ Association, Oregon Chiefs of Police Association, Fraternal Order of Police Oregon Lodge, ORCOPS, Eugene Police Employees’ Association and Crime Victims United of Oregon. These law enforcement leaders know Betsy is the only candidate for governor who will make safety, fighting crime and supporting the rights of crime victims a top priority.
* * *
### **Christine Backs QAnon Candidate for U.S Senate**
Did you see Christine Drazan’s interview in Medford last week? They asked her a straightforward question: Who do you support for U.S. Senate? After dodging the question and blaming the media for her support of disgraced QAnon conspiracy theorist and January 6th insurrectionist Jo Rae Perkins, Drazan said dismissively, “Why do you think I wouldn’t support a fellow Republican?” “I wish all Republican candidates well.” Christine’s lack of courage and common sense is everything wrong with party politics today – capitulation and allegiance to ideology and personality over responsible leadership. It makes her unready and unfit to be governor. Christine should know what most Oregonians know – Jo Rae Perkins has no business being anywhere near the United States Senate. Drazan is either too afraid or too irresponsible to say so. We know that it seems like one $3 donation may not seem like the kind of money that can take on the entire gun lobby and make a difference in expensive races...

subject: 🚨$45 MILLION?!??🚨
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY KAREN BASS FOR MAYOR 2022 – GENERAL
body:
First, I have some good news: A new _Los Angeles Times_ poll shows Karen is in the lead!

But, here's the bad news: **Rick Caruso just funneled $3.5 million of his own personal funds into his campaign to try and buy this race. This means he's officially given up to $45 MILLION to his own campaign.**

Unlike Caruso, the overwhelming majority of contributions to our campaign come from emails just like this one. Every dollar we raise goes directly toward electing Karen as mayor of Los Angeles.

But, something strange is happening. Our finance team says fundraising has slowed down compared to last month. We're seeing fewer donations, and even fewer people are responding to messages like this one.

It means making health care more affordable, bringing economic justice to our communities, and lowering the everyday costs that make it difficult for too many families to make ends meet. **Friend, our movement is about _you_ – your priorities, your concerns, your hopes for the future. When I ran for president in 2020, we had a lot of plans. Universal child care? We had a plan for that. A minimum tax on giant corporations that were paying $0 in federal income taxes? There was a plan for that too. Student debt cancellation? Oh, we definitely had a plan for that. Each plan tackled a different piece of how the rules have been rigged against working people — but no matter which proposal we were talking about, some people had the same feedback over, and over, and over: _“Great idea, but it'll never happen.”_ I was pretty used to it at that point. This is the same thing I was told when I went to Washington to talk about my idea for a government agency to protect consumers from financial scams (spoiler alert: We made the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau a reality). I wasn’t fazed, because here’s the thing — these plans CAN happen, when we fight for them. This month, we passed a 15% minimum tax on giant corporations as part of the Inflation Reduction Act. And just last week, President Biden canceled student debt for tens of millions of Americans. We keep proving the naysayers wrong. We keep showing what it looks like to make our government work for everyone, not just the wealthy and well-connected. It doesn’t all happen overnight, but it gets done because we fought by side as a grassroots movement. [_**We can continue making big, structural change like this. We can make a wealth tax, universal child care, and so much more possible. We just need to build our momentum, organize, and keep fighting side by side. clean_body: Plenty of critics will be quick to tell you what we CAN'T do for working families. | | | When I ran for president in 2020, we had a lot of plans. Universal child care? We had a plan for that. A minimum tax on giant corporations that were paying $0 in federal income taxes? There was a plan for that too. Student debt cancellation? Oh, we definitely had a plan for that. Each plan tackled a different piece of how the rules have been rigged against working people — but no matter which proposal we were talking about, some people had the same feedback over, and over, and over: “Great idea, but it'll never happen.” I was pretty used to it at that point. This is the same thing I was told when I went to Washington to talk about my idea for a government agency to protect consumers from financial scams (spoiler alert: We made the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau a reality). I wasn’t fazed, because here’s the thing — these plans CAN happen, when we fight for them. This month, we passed a 15% minimum tax on giant corporations as part of the Inflation Reduction Act. And just last week, President Biden canceled student debt for tens of millions of Americans. We keep proving the naysayers wrong. We keep showing what it looks like to make our government work for everyone, not just the wealthy and well-connected. It doesn’t all happen overnight, but it gets done because we fought by side as a grassroots movement. = | If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | | | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Once you start talking about helping working people instead of ultra-wealthy corporations, plenty of critics will be quick to tell you what you can’t do and what’s not possible. But these ideas are popular. In a democracy, that matters. And the more change we make, the more momentum we build — by showing we can use the power of government to transform people’s lives. We need to keep laying out bold plans, and here’s the absolutely critical part: We need to be willing to fight for them. I’m going to keep fighting with everything I’ve got — but nobody gets this done on their own. That’s exactly why I launched Warren Democrats. subject: This is dangerous.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican Party of Wisconsin
body:
CSE is here in Wisconsin

| [ ](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=BJAgHetUUIqrbBbKj3z09j9OpIZbBzc5g2-7VwfHf34&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tosa_v1&n=1)
---
Friend - During the COVID lockdowns, parents across Wisconsin were able to look further into what their children are being taught in schools and they were outraged. Last year, Merrick Garland and the Biden DOJ labeled parents speaking up at school board meetings **[as domestic terrorists](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=nPFaTKas50gnV2FjfYL96tY5MrS3abNPVXdn_qxHg0ElWa5aRAC1q0V6GDkIx5cEcR77tMYL6KC7iHR2Xq_LEQ&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tosa_v1&n=2)**. As schools in America focus more on woke sex-education and less on reading and math, we were told to sit down and be quiet. Our concerns have been dismissed as ‘Republican talking points’ and ‘scare tactics’ **. . . . . . But if only that was the case** **. . . . . . **

* * *
Last week, the Wauwatosa School District [**approved a wildly radical form of sexual education**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=ez1BnRg01gPGR4qyG5PO2HpkS_28ih52oCxnRZIo6MkMEZGUUCxRyo5kZheDq73mQz7sUt9wzEgNfBfo5NyLHioYwgjf0_rA4Tjbgdb-NSOfONm1exhuRiDQ104EYVpJtiFoGtC5SKANXy9Qov72v_NhBYEmAbyxslrkhQLlr6GRMq707bgYxote1gN0NAyyHei3Hp-cFOEYhTktoswiCA&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tosa_v1&n=3) that is being pushed by national far-left organizations to adopt a set of far-left national education standards known as Comprehensive Sex Ed (**CSE**). Starting in Kindergarten, students will learn about **consent** , **gender identity** , **hormone blockers** , and **healthy relationships**. The curriculum was written by an organization called '**SIECUS: Sex Ed for Social Change** '. This CSE program is not meant to educate and inform; at its core, **CSE is a vehicle for dangerous social and political change that starts with kids as young as 5-years old** and has partnered with organizations that:

* Promote promiscuous early-age sex education (as young as Kindergarten, 5 yo)
* Fight to **[abolish parental involvement laws](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=yDJRJ3e1STIBd-W-5BNmK7WW-URnPqiQ5oevI1vZRCllHeZ76KEkw50XkE1SO_moasa4pwe5YAkcYq2D6my9616QrBfemKdame-OgpBDb2V8_VPYNXHhnXURMnc3AUia&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tosa_v1&n=4) **
* Prioritize access to abortion over policing communities

We know this is only one school district, but we want to raise awareness about the ideas and values that are being pushed onto our kids, but most importantly, we need to let you know that **CSE is already here!** The Wisconsin Department of Public Instruction [**approved this curriculum last year**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=a9lVzACUQtvW78T1Y1IgXSTAWhYy73r-ZfSkFnsT9TH0UyY65uX_hI4sPGuWxwxOBcfVd2X3srcjOuvQtiDqtyYSSvt_l1bsQWk9-aScW2fO963-fehDQQSMAfzPdK1h&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tosa_v1&n=5). Additionally, this similar curriculum was adopted by the Illinois Legislature in 2021, but [**a significant majority of IL schools choose to opt-out**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=1Md8n-ixLwkzQmZ02kVykADOmRW4PJqGM8SE6Vlf9Kp3v_VGaNqEjkab_F9kR4eA114yNWSNJnSGEE1SMnP9_lAHV7j3aVmqD4znusRWvnROTpGOvZIjxwRy7oR7g1C7TK_xy2viX4m329HV1BWv8zz9sGvhX9L-fdzlfRsuPrQWvvRJX2XZvfV2OO69fwNBjBGAmqroeWVO24108OBFlzcsONSERpzUtKhDjkXdKCQPHec59qYaH_BbXZKXjB7A&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tosa_v1&n=6) of teaching this curriculum.
* * *
Friend, the far-left hides its dangerous ideas under a moderate facade, but at the end of the day, they’re abusing their power in schools and pushing to remove parents from their child’s education. This isn’t some made-up scare tactic that is happening far away from us. These are truly radical ideologies infiltrating the education system in our own backyards. **Friend, we have to put an end to this.** Sign up below to help us to elect no-nonsense conservatives up-and-down the ballot. | [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0eXv_5DaexUSZI9PlfXgIO8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tosa_v1&n=7 "Volunteer") [Volunteer](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0eXv_5DaexUSZI9PlfXgIO8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tosa_v1&n=7)

The short version: I’m up against the clock on my monthly fundraising deadline and will miss it unless we take action immediately. Remember, I’m running in a district we barely flipped in 2020, and fighting tooth and nail to keep in red. The long version: This is what I didn’t want to have to send you, Fellow American. I know how bad things are right now. People are struggling to afford rent, buy groceries, and fill up their tank at the gas pump. I’ve been there. Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck. At 17 years old, I dropped out of high school and started waitressing at the local Waffle House to put food on the table. I didn’t grow up with millions in the bank, and a silver spoon in my mouth. My dad was an Army General and my mom a schoolteacher. My parents taught me the key to success, work. And working is what I’ve been doing since I was 17. Congress is in desperate need of someone to come in and shake things up – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other. Peter,
The right to a safe and legal abortion is on the ballot this November.
21 million — about 1 in 3 girls and women in the US between the ages of 15 and 44 — have lost access to abortion care, according to U.S. census data.
Thirteen states had trigger bans ready for when the Supreme Court was to overturn Roe v. Wade. Three states had trigger laws that included a 30-day waiting period before the abortion ban could take effect, which ended on Aug. 25.
We must take our fight to the states to fight for women’s rights and for reproductive care. Will you join us in support? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moms4roevwade]
Idaho’s trigger law will make nearly all abortions illegal, leaving exceptions for rape, incest and to protect the life of the mother. It went into effect on Aug. 25.
In Texas, a trigger law that bans most abortions kicked in on Aug. 25, also making no exceptions for rape or incest.
In Tennessee, a trigger ban is now also in place as of Aug. 25 and it will ban nearly all abortions, except in cases to prevent the death or serious injury of a pregnant woman.
The battleground for reproductive choice for women is now at the state level.
This is why we set a goal to raise $5,000 to support democratic women running for office in states where abortion bans went into effect. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moms4roevwade]
Can you help us support pro-choice Democratic women running for office in states with trigger bans? We need these candidates on the state level to lead the charge for abortion access. These pro-choice champions are counting on our support. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moms4roevwade]

Thirteen states had trigger bans ready for when the Supreme Court was to overturn Roe v. Wade. Three states had trigger laws that included a 30-day waiting period before the abortion ban could take effect, which ended on Aug. 25. We must take our fight to the states to fight for women’s rights and for reproductive care. Will you join us in support? [] Idaho’s trigger law will make nearly all abortions illegal, leaving exceptions for rape, incest and to protect the life of the mother. It went into effect on Aug. 25. In Texas, a trigger law that bans most abortions kicked in on Aug. 25, also making no exceptions for rape or incest. In Tennessee, a trigger ban is now also in place as of Aug. 25 and it will ban nearly all abortions, except in cases to prevent the death or serious injury of a pregnant woman. The battleground for reproductive choice for women is now at the state level. This is why we set a goal to raise $5,000 to support democratic women running for office in states where abortion bans went into effect. They are giving us hints with abortion - national bans criminalizing women's healthcare, throwing doctors in jail. This is the tip of the iceberg. But we have a chance here in CA-9 to fight back. We're one of the most competitive races in the country - the most recent poll shows us tied! If you want to fight Republican extremism, this is the race to give to. We are officially up with our TV ads and we need your help to keep them up. It's incredibly urgent given our extremist Republican opponent could go up on air any day now. Who controls Congress comes down to what happens right here in California 's 9th district. And if we fall short, we lose the House and Tom Patti joins extremists like Marjorie Taylor Greene in DC. It's that simple. Your contributions are what's going to make the difference, Josh Harder * = =

subject: Marco Rubio had the Florida Republican Party credit card handy to abuse and a Senate seat from which to advertise his book, so he thinks dealing with $100,000 in student debt should be easy for everyone. Val Demings knows better, and that’s why she should be the next Senator from Florida.
body:
Student debt is easy for Senators like Marco Rubio
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, student loans are easy to deal with ... says Marco Rubio. **He bragged that he erased 100K of personal debt without help. You could too if you work hard like him...**
_Yup. This past weekend, L'il Marco Rubio told you if you could just write a book like he did (Anyone has time for that! We all get Fridays off like Senators, work half the year and get free tv time to promote our books!), you'd get out of debt! I was born and raised in Milwaukee. I don’t come from a wealthy or well-connected family. But I do come from a proud union family.
My mom was a Milwaukee school teacher for 30 years, and my dad worked 3rd shift at the General Motors plant. Those jobs were my family's ticket to the middle class.
My parents spent their days organizing for better wages and advancing workers' rights. Their example showed me the importance of coming together around shared values and fighting for opportunity for everyone.
The current system isn't working for people in Wisconsin and across the country. Hard work just isn't paying off like it used to. People are working longer and longer for less and less while big corporations and CEOs bring in larger profits than ever before.
**That's why we can't settle for what is – we have to reach for what can be.**
Now that we're up against Ron Johnson, we will be facing some very powerful special interest groups and right-wing super PACs that want to stop our campaign.
They will pour tens of millions of dollars into negative ads to try to defeat me and prop up Ron Johnson. The truth is that they will stop at nothing to defend this seat.
**So we need to be ready for whatever they will throw our way, which means I am relying on lots of people making contributions to help flip Wisconsin's Senate seat and defend the Senate majority. **

subject: The situation is getting serious now
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
We need all hands on deck.
#
Peter,
I know that time is precious, so I’ll get straight to the point. Every week, month, and quarter, my team works hard to set ambitious but achievable fundraising goals. It’s essential we hit them.
This month, our fundraising projections are not looking good. **We’re 32% behind** where we were at this time last month. That’s a major drop in fundraising. **Put simply, we need to raise about $21,573 to hit our August goal.**
The situation is getting serious, and we need all hands on deck. I can’t emphasize it enough: it’s critical we raise that amount by Wednesday at midnight to stay on track.
[**I understand it’s a big ask, Peter, but every dollar adds up. So can I count on your $3 contribution to help us raise $21,573 by midnight on Wednesday?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16204?refcode=em20220829-1560&t=1&akid=1560%2E420207%2EV2L_A4)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16204?refcode=em20220829-1560&t=20&akid=1560%2E420207%2EV2L_A4)**
I won’t sugarcoat it: these numbers are very concerning. **We’re talking about a 32% decline in fundraising in only one month.**
In a field flooded with corporate money and super PACs, the odds are still stacked against progressives. **I don’t ask for donations for the sake of it.**
The funds we raise keep our campaign running – we never know what’s going to happen. They also allow me to support other progressive candidates on the ground and share resources in pivotal races.
I’m committed to this fight for the long haul, but that requires strong, sustained fundraising. **And to be honest, we are way behind.**
[**We have just two days to raise $21,573, so I have to ask again: will you donate $3 or any amount right now, so we can close this gap?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16204?refcode=em20220829-1560&t=21&akid=1560%2E420207%2EV2L_A4)
In solidarity,
Pramila

**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20220829-1560-footer&t=22&refcode2=1560_420207_V2L_A4&akid=1560%2E420207%2EV2L_A4)**

clean_body: I’ll be blunt: I need your help | Hey Peter, I bet you could guess what I’m about to say. But please listen to what I have to say. I’ll be blunt: Republican fundraising is down across the board, and well-funded Dems are taking to the airwaves to attack us. In the last month, we were outspent 7 to 1 on TV alone. Our campaign is reaching another fundraising deadline, and we’re behind our goal. Please trust me when I say that fundraising is absolutely crucial to our campaign. We need materials for our volunteers, yard signs for our supporters, and funds to run ads. | I understand that you may not have much to give, but I promise you that every dollar invested in our campaign brings us one step closer to restoring our American way of life and stopping the woke Biden agenda. I promise you that I will work hard to secure our border, stop inflation, and defend our freedoms. Tina for Oregon [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92654/images/TinaForOregon-Logo-FullColor-white.png]
Dear Friends,

Last night, shoppers at a Safeway in Bend were terrorized by a man who opened fire with an AR-15 style weapon — two people were killed, including a store employee who tried to stop him.

My heart hurts for the victims, for their loved ones, and for the entire Bend community.

Once again, a community is shattered by a senseless act of deadly violence. Once again, a community has to take up the task of healing from a preventable tragedy.

This has to stop. We all want this to be different.

As Governor, I will keep fighting to keep guns away from those who are likely to harm themselves or others. I will keep fighting to keep weapons of war out of the hands of teenagers. I know we can figure this out.

Let us send our love to the people of Bend today, and then, let’s keep fighting together.

Best,
Tina

Portland, OR 97242

body:
| Hi there,

I’m Dr. Elizabeth Mack and I work with Dr. Andrews.

body:
We’re building a Working Families Majority right now. | | | Peter, Everything about the 2022 elections has changed over the past three months: **In June, the right-wing Supreme Court stripped people seeking abortions of their right to control their own bodies.** In response, we have seen a massive increase in grassroots energy — including at the ballot box in special elections and primaries. Together, we have mobilized every day since the decision to elect WFP champions to Congress who will eliminate the filibuster, expand the Supreme Court, and secure abortion rights into federal law. **Then earlier this month, Democrats in Congress passed the Inflation Reduction Act, a major down payment towards a clean energy future.** This bill, signed into law by President Biden, is the single most consequential climate change legislation in history. It invests billions in the development of green technology and jobs, and makes the wealthy and corporations foot the bill. **And just last week, President Biden announced his plan to tackle the student debt crisis.** His executive action includes federal student loan forgiveness of up to $20,000 for some borrowers and adjustments to the income requirements for paying back federal loans. It will change lives for millions. It's also a credit to years of organizing. And we know the student debt cancelation movement will only gain more momentum. **With 70 days to go until Election Day, our fight to elect a working families majority to both houses of Congress that will pass a full working peoples' agenda is looking more winnable than ever.** But many of our candidates are facing tough opponents and millions in Super PAC spending in November. We always knew that would be the case — which is why we set ambitious online fundraising goals for each month at the beginning of the year. With just a few more deadlines to go until Election Day, it is important that we meet each and every one of them. **[We have $6,680 left to hit our online fundraising goal for August 2022. clean_body: We’re building a Working Families Majority right now. | | | Peter, Everything about the 2022 elections has changed over the past three months: In June, the right-wing Supreme Court stripped people seeking abortions of their right to control their own bodies. In response, we have seen a massive increase in grassroots energy — including at the ballot box in special elections and primaries. Together, we have mobilized every day since the decision to elect WFP champions to Congress who will eliminate the filibuster, expand the Supreme Court, and secure abortion rights into federal law. Then earlier this month, Democrats in Congress passed the Inflation Reduction Act, a major down payment towards a clean energy future. This bill, signed into law by President Biden, is the single most consequential climate change legislation in history. It invests billions in the development of green technology and jobs, and makes the wealthy and corporations foot the bill. And just last week, President Biden announced his plan to tackle the student debt crisis. His executive action includes federal student loan forgiveness of up to $20,000 for some borrowers and adjustments to the income requirements for paying back federal loans. It will change lives for millions. It's also a credit to years of organizing. And we know the student debt cancelation movement will only gain more momentum. With 70 days to go until Election Day, our fight to elect a working families majority to both houses of Congress that will pass a full working peoples' agenda is looking more winnable than ever. But many of our candidates are facing tough opponents and millions in Super PAC spending in November. We always knew that would be the case — which is why we set ambitious online fundraising goals for each month at the beginning of the year. With just a few more deadlines to go until Election Day, it is important that we meet each and every one of them. In solidarity, The Working Families Party team Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If you received this email as a forward and want to get the latest updates from the Working Families Party directly, The Working Families Party is the party of the multiracial working class, fighting for a nation that cares for all of us. News at 11: Entitled politician complains about entitlement.

| | | | | Peter, student loans are easy to deal with ... says Marco Rubio. **He bragged that he erased 100K of personal debt without help. You could too if you work hard like him...**
_Yup. This past weekend, L'il Marco Rubio told you if you could just write a book like he did (Anyone has time for that! We all get Fridays off like Senators, work half the year and get free tv time to promote our books!), you'd get out of debt! Easy-peasy, right!?_ **“I owed over $100,000 in student loans, the day I got elected to the Senate I had over $100,000 still in student loans that I was able to pay off because I wrote a book and from that money I was able to pay it.”** If this sounds like an insult, it is. Marco took advantage of his government position and high profile for profit. So the rest of us who can't do that...are just lazy and willing to be in debt? Yep, in the world according to L'il Marco. It gets worse, though. You see, Marco had the Florida Republican Party credit card handy to abuse. You have that too, right?? Take it away, Tampa Bay Times: "..**The Times Herald**** _obtained Rubio's statements from 2006 and 2007, showing he routinely charged personal expenses[ ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1a1e8ff8-c69b-4c26-b6a7-4437a58619a7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)from a $10.50 movie ticket to a four-day, $10,000 family reunion._** [**Join us in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can to Val Demings.** Let's give Val Demings a Senate seat, and give Marco back his Florida GOP credit card. He clearly needs it.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T45d4f156-dbb6-4fdd-a574-8c9d2ccdd1a1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **From January of 2005 until October of 2008 I charged about $160,000 in party-authorized expenses. "**** ****_Who's the con man again?_**

_Your contribution will be split between Mark Kelly for Senate and the DSCC to keep Arizona and the Senate blue._
Friends —

I’ll be honest with you:

When Gabby and I got married, I never thought this is the way things would turn out.

I never thought I’d run for public office. She was the elected official in the family — and on the International Space Station, I was about as far from Congress as you can get.

I never thought more than 1 million people would contribute and volunteer to help elect me.

And I never thought that I’d need to ask you to do more than that to defend this seat.

But I do need to ask you to do more. We are facing millions of dollars in attack ads, Trump says beating me is the first step to "taking America back," and we’ve missed a few fundraising goals in a row already this year.

So please. You may not have woken up this morning thinking you’d make a donation to my re-election and the DSCC, but **I really need you if we’re going to hold Arizona’s seat and our Senate majority against the National Republican groups coming to take them.**
